title: New application-style broad corpus
description: Cross-language comparison on eight previously unused application workflows, including exact filesystem output judgment.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict application-corpus parity.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
All eight task IDs and statements are new relative to iterations 001-022; no output may be used to revise this frozen corpus.
The file-backed task deletes the expected output before every case and judges exact UTF-8 contents as well as stdout.
Cross-iteration effort movement is descriptive only because the workload changed from compact algorithms to richer application workflows.
secondary_analysis: Report all sessions, task outcomes, repairs, tokens, elapsed time, prompt size, source size, integrity, and command-protocol compliance.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by task family and independent session.
Audit whether generated solutions actually exercise file operations on file_backed_notes and whether richer work changes Parley-to-Rust source-size ratios.
Report repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass all eight tasks on the first check.
feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155. No compiler, grammar, AST, runtime, skill, prompt, or checker diagnostic changed after iteration 022; only the language-neutral benchmark harness gained exact expected-file judgment.
change_rule: No syntax or compiler behavior may be added from one task, transcript, session, or token gap. A proposal requires recurrence across unrelated new tasks and independent sessions, then separate review for general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability. Checker-totality defects remain correctness bugs.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review, and subsequent efficiency evidence must use new tasks.
